name: Garage
short_desc: S3-compatible object storage for a single homelab node.
author: Deuxfleurs
description: Single-node Garage S3 API behind Traefik. Path-style requests on the exposed domain, with a default bucket and key created on first start.

form_fields.label: S3 root domain
form_fields.hint: Public hostname with a leading dot, matching the Traefik domain. Use .s3.gurmen.net so https://s3.gurmen.net is the API root. .gurmen.net would treat the host s3 as a bucket name.

form_fields.label: S3 region
form_fields.hint: Region clients must send. Garage rejects any other region.

form_fields.label: Default bucket
form_fields.hint: Created on first start only. Changing this later does not rename the bucket.

form_fields.label: S3 access key suffix
form_fields.hint: The key ID is GK plus this value. It is written in full to the app data config/s3-credentials.txt. Leave the generated hex. Changing it after first start stops Garage.

form_fields.label: S3 secret key
form_fields.hint: Secret for the default access key. Leave the generated hex. Changing it after first start stops Garage.

form_fields.label: RPC secret
form_fields.hint: Cluster secret, 32 bytes of hex. Leave the generated value. Changing it after first start makes existing data unreachable.

form_fields.label: Admin token
form_fields.hint: Token for the admin API on 127.0.0.1:3903 inside the container. Not published through Traefik.

form_fields.label: Metrics token
form_fields.hint: Token required for the Prometheus /metrics endpoint on the admin port.
